warranty: New parts only, with the manufacturer's warranty.
Fitting work guaranteed for 3 months or 5,000 km.
We keep your old parts to show you, if you wish.

items.q: How do I know the part fits my car?
items.a: Send us your VIN or a photo of the registration paper and the old part. We check the exact reference before you buy.
Yes, within the city by motorbike courier on the same day for parts in stock; the fee depends on the distance.
Unused parts in their original box can be returned within 7 days with the receipt. Electrical parts that have been fitted cannot be returned.

items.q: Do I need to book the workshop?
items.a: Booking by phone or Zalo is best; walk-ins are welcome when a bay is free.

items.q: Do you sell original or aftermarket parts?
items.a: Both. We explain the difference in price and lifetime, and you choose.

visit.title: Bring the old part, we'll match it
visit.text: Come to the counter with your old part or your car papers, or call and message us on Zalo first.
visit.note: Workshop: last job accepted one hour before closing.
